description: This file defines a React context provider component for managing user session state in a web frontend application. It includes hooks and context for accessing and refreshing the session data, which is fetched from an authentication library.

methods.name: useSession
methods.description: Custom hook to access current session context (user and loading state).

methods.name: SessionProvider
methods.description: React component that provides session context to its children by fetching session data asynchronously.
